description: This file provides external interface implementations for OpenCDM system extensions, including session management, secure stop handling, and hash retrieval, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_ldl_session_limit
methods.description: Retrieves the LDL session limit from the system, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_is_secure_stop_enabled
methods.description: Indicates whether secure stop is enabled; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_enable_secure_stop
methods.description: Attempts to enable secure stop; not supported, returns failure.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_reset_secure_stop
methods.description: Resets secure stop; not supported, returns failure.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop_ids
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs; not supported, returns failure.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data; not supported, returns failure.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_commit_secure_stop
methods.description: Commits secure stop data; not supported, returns failure.

methods.name: opencdm_get_key_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the key store hash from the system, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_get_secure_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the secure store hash from the system, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_delete_key_store
methods.description: Deletes the key store from the system, with error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_delete_secure_store
methods.description: Deletes the secure store from the system, with error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_drm_header
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for a session, with validation and logging.

methods.name: opencdm_session_get_challenge_data
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for a session, initializing session if needed.

methods.name: opencdm_session_cancel_challenge_data
methods.description: Cancels challenge data; no operation performed.

methods.name: opencdm_session_store_license_data
methods.description: Stores license data into a session, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_session_select_key_id
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a session, with validation.

methods.name: opencdm_system_teardown
methods.description: Performs system teardown; currently a no-op.

methods.name: opencdm_session_clean_decrypt_context
methods.description: Cleans up the decrypt context by closing the session.
